item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Pakistani Mediators Arrive in Iran to Keep Peace Talks Alive
item.summary: The diplomacy came as the White House dismissed reports that President Trump wanted to extend the cease-fire, while still expressing optimism that talks could yield an agreement.

item.title: Dodging Bombs and Drones, This Postman in Ukraine Still Delivers
item.summary: Oleksiy Klochkovsky has driven mail and parcels around the front line in Ukraine for four years. He keeps one ear tuned for danger from above.

item.title: Top U.S. Diplomat in Venezuela Leaves Post After Arriving in January
item.summary: Laura Dogu, who reopened the U.S. Embassy in Venezuela, returns to advising Gen. Dan Caine, the highest ranking U.S. military officer, as the war with Iran continues.

item.title: With Iran War on Pause, Political Battle Resumes Over Israeli Democracy
item.summary: A court fight over Itamar Ben-Gvir, an extremist who oversees the police, pits the attorney general against Benjamin Netanyahu and his right-wing government.

item.title: ‘We Cannot Lose Sight of Ukraine.’ Europeans Promise More Aid to Kyiv.
item.summary: The focus in recent weeks has been on the conflict in Iran, but European leaders said it was crucial to keep aid flowing to Ukraine.

item.title: After Fighting for the Rights of Workers, Brazil’s President Lula Faces a Labor Abuse Crisis
item.summary: The dismissal of Brazil’s top labor inspector has landed the leftist government of President Lula, a former union leader, in an awkward spot.

item.title: Kuwait Detained Journalist After Comments on Iran War Images, Watchdog Says
item.summary: The country has not commented publicly about Ahmed Shihab-Eldin, who the Committee to Protect Journalists said had been charged with spreading false information.

item.title: Sudan Enters Fourth Year of War Amid World’s Most Severe Humanitarian Crisis
item.summary: Fighting that erupted in 2023 has forced millions from their homes and left widespread hunger that is now being compounded by strife in the Middle East.

item.title: Trump’s Portrayal of the War in Iran Collides With Reality
item.summary: President Trump is confronting a crisis that is not bending to his narrative of a “pretty reasonable” new regime in Iran and all-but-assured victory for the United States.

item.title: How China’s Weapons Transfers to Iran Have Evolved Over Decades
item.summary: China has denied claims this month by U.S. intelligence that it might have shipped arms to Iran. In recent years, China has supported Iran with dual-use parts.
